|game_text=If Send A Detachment Down on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. During battle at a Tatooine site, may place Tactical Support out of play from Lost Pile to add 2 to attrition against opponent.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[TD-110]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[TD-110 (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 21 July 2024<ref name="ht-63a0ee1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual23-Dark/large/td110.gif</code> as published 21 July 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/63a0ee1a7d7c0170dd5d75d69fefd6d973cd8f47/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/td110.gif holotable commit 63a0ee1] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If Send A Detachment Down on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. During battle at a Tatooine site, may place Tactical Support out of play from Lost Pile to add 2 to attrition against opponent.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[TD-110 (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 2 August 2024: “If Send A Detachment Down on table, destiny +2 when drawn for destiny. During battle at a Tatooine site, may place Tactical Support out of play from Lost Pile to add 2 to attrition against opponent.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[TD-110]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[TD-110]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•TD-110”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
